profile.headline: Software Development Manager at Long Term Solutions

positions.title: Sr. Software Developer
positions.description:
•Design and develop all past and future internal proprietary applications using Microsoft technology Stack including C#.NET MVC, SQL Server, JavaScript/AJAX.
•Meet with COO to discuss software project milestones and timelines.
•Manage individual developer project plans to develop a solution within the projected deadline.
•Coordinate QA resources and test plans in order to minimize bugs and functionality discrepancies.
•Give presentations to our clients regarding our internal software architecture and security.
•Analyze business needs and re-architect solutions to provide greater process efficiencies.

positions.title: Remediation Project Manager
positions.description:
*Lead meetings with technology subject matter experts regarding software architecture remediation solutions and strategies.
*Coordinate key members of TJX internal applications to develop time and cost estimates.
*Present remediation solution proposal to TJX Corporate Technology Governance Board in order to get funding approved.
*Analyze applications deemed in need of remediation and determine the most cost effective solution.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description:
*Provide major contributions to Satuit development C#.NET, T-SQL and javascript coding and design standards.
*Design and Develop key projects within version 12 of our flagship product SatuitCRM including components such as a scheduler/calendar, dashboard, a workflow system and several configuration tools. 
*Perform R&D on client/javascript AJAX library DHTMLX  in turn becoming a subject matter expert when integrating AJAX library with C#.Net 3.5 class libraries.
*Optimize existing SQL queries and C#.Net libraries to current Satuit standards.  
*Work closely with QA, Client Services, IT and Professional Services teams to optimize product's value to users.

positions.title: Sr. Application Engineer
positions.description:
*Coordinate with external clients to ensure 100% satisfaction with the final implementation.
	* Lead meetings with all stakeholders throughout the life cycle of the project.
	*Develop .NET client DLLs to integrate with ARCHIBUS flagship project.
	*Prototype flash API utility using JAVA/Javascript to be implemented within the core product.
	*Perform all technical analysis and development to customize web product to client
 	  specifications.
	*Update sql scripts to streamline future implementation projects.

positions.title: Application Developer Consultant
positions.description:
*Design and architect an extranet system to enhance sales interest over our competitors.
	* Build ASP.NET 2.0 utility tools to allow collectors/managers to perform queries on third 
	  party data management system.
	*Develop a mid-sized letter management system utilizing several custom built extensible 
	  middle-tier objects.
	*Architect scalable database structures which include normalized tables, stored procedures,
	  table views and scalar functions.
	*Complete full life-cycle of development from inception, requirements gathering, system
	  analysis, development, QA and release.
	*Streamline several internal processes by automating existing procedures using BizTalk 2006.
	*Integrate both IIS/SQL 2005 security within all .NET projects.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
*Integrate scalable C#.Net libraries for reuse within multiple .NET applications.
*Perform enhancements on applications using current Microsoft Technologies, C#.NET, VB.NET, SQL 2000.
*Gather requirements to assess specific needs in order to provide the most efficient tool which meets the business objective. 	  
*Transition existing legacy ASP code to the current .NET platform in order to integrate class libraries within the solution.
*Aid in developing an ETL (Extract Transform Load) web service application.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
*Design, Build and architect custom solutions for Satuit clients using current Microsoft Technologies, C#.NET, VB.NET, SQL 2000.
*Extract data from a diverse set of client databases and perform custom imports through transact SQL queries and DTS.
*Develop enhancements to our CRM import tool to streamline the import of client data using appropriate technology tools.
*Perform on-demand custom data enhancements(T-SQL) for clients after coordinating with client service team.
*Collect specifications and existing needs from client service and clients for future development projects.
